description: 2D dam break: a rigid timber block (material timber C24 rigid, stiffness 2e5 N/m) on the dry bed is pushed by the surge onto an elastic post (fix base) and the ground.
covers: FEM rigid-body contact as one spring of the debris stiffness (ground plane, deformable post)
contact force on the body mass alone (added-mass stabilisation of the fluid loads only)
impact time step near walls / ground
